title: Command Registry as Menu Flattening
description: Why the command registry draws directly from the menu tree.
body: There is no second table of commands here: the menu model is rebuilt from live state every render and already carries every field a palette row needs, so this flattens it. One source of truth by construction rather than by discipline. A command has to be *in a menu* to be in the palette — that is the right constraint, since a palette-only command would be an action with no discoverable home.
